independent_technical_reasoning: The critical discriminator from the uncorrectable GFX case is ext58 plus corrected severity rather than ext59/fatal. The tool names block2 GFX while the decoder expects bank GC, so their mapping must be approved rather than assumed. A new entry number alone is ambiguous; the OAM and fields must coexist in one attributable, integrity-checked CPER. Any fatal escalation or continuing events invalidate safe completion and prohibit retry.
